classes.name: masks
classes.reason: In the measure loop the rank calls probe.read_staged on the class_a path and times it as 'gated' stall before it can proceed to probe.sleep_seconds(compute_s), so the reading rank itself stalls once per class_a file with no collective barrier involving other ranks.

classes.name: tiles
classes.reason: class_b files are read once each by the separate _prefetch multiprocessing.Process feeding a bounded queue, so the reads overlap the main rank's compute/sleep and only the prefetch worker itself is at the read.
